attributes.comment: Addressed durability test feedback on side-panel attachments.
Opened the next change window for interface updates with adjacent modules.
Updated fabrication sequence to match new weld fixtures on the line.
Rerouted bus bars to improve service access in the field.
Carried forward pending harness changes into the main product line.
Established a released baseline for dependent assemblies.
Frozen latch hard points ahead of sealing tool design.
Adjusted wheel-arch envelope for a new wheel and tire combination.
Added mounting features for the next-generation display module.
Rebalanced wiring channels after harness routing study.
Baseline enclosure layout for initial crash and leak correlation.
Thermal layout change driven by a new cell module supplier.
Branched layout to satisfy regional packaging regulations.
Early shell used for fit and clearance checks before crash iterations.
Simplified carrier concept for a cost-focused trim level.
Lightweight enclosure concept targeting extended-range packaging.
Bench PDU layout to validate routing before merging into the main line.
Absorbed the regional mid-body variant into the primary design line.
Merged prototype enclosure learnings into the active development revision.
Folded the value-trim carrier concept into the main instrument panel line.
Incorporated bench PDU validation results into the consolidated PDU revision.
Pulled lightweight enclosure changes into the current pack development revision.
Early thermal packaging study forked from the young production baseline.
Merged thermal study results into the trunk before homologation freeze.
Regional derivative for EMEA connector and cooling regulations.
Integrated EMEA packaging into the main inverter line.
EMC bench layout study; left unmerged after scope moved to supplier lab.
High-performance derivative abandoned after motor map change.
Short busbar routing experiment on the performance derivative path.
Absorbed busbar experiment into trunk ahead of SOP build.
Field retrofit derivative for legacy vehicle fleets.
Merged retrofit interfaces into the active production trunk.
Cost-down study targeting magnet wire and housing suppliers.
Integrated cost-down proposals at the pre-PPAP gate.
Lightweight enclosure derivative spawned from the cost-down study.
Pulled enclosure mass reduction into the consolidated trunk.
Gen2 silicon-carbide module feasibility study.
Merged module study into trunk for the next platform drop.
Cold-plate derivative for extreme climate markets.
Integrated cold-plate variant before winter validation sign-off.
Pilot line tryout study for adhesive dispensing and torquing.
Merged pilot line feedback into the manufacturing intent trunk.
SIL harness study; superseded by consolidated HIL program.
Export-market homologation derivative (unique labeling and fusing).
Integrated export homologation package into the late trunk.
Late acoustic mitigation study on the export derivative line.
Merged acoustic treatments into the trunk before final release.
Nested shielding study branched from the EMC bench line.
Folded shielding learnings back through the bench study into trunk.
Short busbar routing experiment on the performance derivative path.
Absorbed busbar experiment into trunk ahead of SOP build.
